Programın ana esin kaynağı. Kart düşürme: The main inspiration for this app. The idea that cards can be farmed without opening a Steam client, simply by reporting a game as "being played", came from here. Studying its approach taught us how to build the queue and in what order it makes sense to handle games.
A maintained fork of Idle Master. After the original project was abandoned we followed this one to see what changed on Steam's side and which behaviours still hold; it also showed which settings are actually worth exposing to the user.
Saat yükseltme tarafındaki esin kaynağım: Our inspiration on the hour-boosting side. From its approach we learned that several games can be held open at once and what that means for playtime accrual. This is why the Hour Booster tab exists.
Başarımların oyun açılmadan okunup değiş: The project that showed achievements can be read and changed without launching the game. It helped us understand how the achievement schema and unlock state are stored on Steam's side; the Achievements tab was built on that idea with our own code.
İki başarım açılışı arasında beklenecek: The wait between two achievement unlocks. The actual delay varies randomly around this value (±40%) each time, so the unlocks do not form a fixed rhythm. With "Spread unlocks over time" on, the variation is much wider. 1 second is the fastest option; unlocking hundreds of achievements in a very short time stands out on your profile.

Pencere ekranda durup odakta değilken sa: While the window sits on screen without focus, the per-second updates and the spinning animations stop. Sharing a desktop with a fullscreen game, this lets the desktop compositor leave the game its presentation path, so the frame rate holds. Background work is untouched; only drawing stops.
Chromium, arayüzü çizerken Windows üzeri: Chromium draws the interface through D3D11 on Windows. Some Intel and older AMD drivers stall on that path; D3D9 or OpenGL fixes it. Automatic is whatever Chromium picks. Changing this needs a restart.
Kapalıyken pencerenin kareleri işlemcide: With this off the window’s frames are composited on the processor and the graphics card is never touched. It leaves the card entirely to your game, at the cost of a few points of CPU. Needs a restart.
Oyun kapak görselleri ve indirilen sayfa: Game cover art and downloaded page assets are dropped from memory and disk. No settings, session or statistics are lost; everything removed is fetched again when needed. On a long running session this is the most direct way to get memory back.

Seçili oyunların toplam oynanma süreleri: Brings the total playtime of the selected games to the same point. Because Steam accrues time for every game that is open at once, the ones behind are brought forward in stages: with games at 8, 11 and 101 hours, the 8-hour one is first raised to 11 on its own, then both are raised to 101 together, and finally all three continue as one. Before starting you are shown how many stages are needed and how long it will take.
Açıkken oturum süresi ayarlardan hesapla: When on, the session length is derived from the settings: how long a real player would take to earn the remaining achievements. It is clamped between fifteen minutes and twelve hours. If you type a value into the duration field, automatic assignment stays off for that session.
